jobs.text: The last few, the ones who like the office, can stay if they want. They've got seniority.

jobs.speaker: RENATA
jobs.text: Still coming. I'll be at the yard gate when you're ready. Text me when they're moving. Or don't. I'll know.
jobs.tts_text: Still coming. I'll be at the yard gate when you're ready. Text me when they're moving. Or don't. I'll know.

jobs.text: Okay. Where are they living? What are they eating? And is there a safe place we can take them?
jobs.tts_text: Okay. Where are they living? What are they eating? And is there a safe place we can take them?

jobs.text: How many?

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: Not now. I'm counting.
jobs.tts_text: Not now. I'm counting.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact. not looking.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: Thanks. It's at 147. It's always at 147.
jobs.tts_text: Thanks. It's at 147. It's always at 147.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: My clicker. Where was it?
jobs.tts_text: My clicker. Where was it?
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact. staring at the tally counter as if it were an old friend.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: I've been counting cats by memory. Do you know how hard that is? I'm at 143. Or 147. It depends when I look.
jobs.tts_text: I've been counting cats by memory. Do you know how hard that is? I'm at 143. Or 147. It depends when I look.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact. a long breath.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: Okay. You want to know where the trailers actually are. Not where the WMS thinks. Here.
jobs.tts_text: Okay. You want to know where the trailers actually are. Not where the WMS thinks. Here.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: Only in the computer. That's a different place.
jobs.tts_text: Only in the computer. That's a different place.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: Cats. I started counting trailers this morning, and I got to the cats. Now I can't stop.
jobs.tts_text: Cats. I started counting trailers this morning, and I got to the cats. Now I can't stop.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: 141... 142... don't talk to me for a second. 143.
jobs.tts_text: 141... 142... don't talk to me for a second. 143.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact. not looking up.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: I know where every trailer is. Every single one. But I can't tell you without my clicker. Lost it Thursday. I'm off count without it.
jobs.tts_text: I know where every trailer is. Every single one. But I can't tell you without my clicker. Lost it Thursday. I'm off count without it.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: Row C, spot 9. Out past the fuel island. When you need it at the dock, radio me from the outbound dock. I need eyes at the door: a spotter to tell me when it's clear.
jobs.tts_text: Row C, spot 9. Out past the fuel island. When you need it at the dock, radio me from the outbound dock. I need eyes at the door: a spotter to tell me when it's clear.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: It's gone. 11:59. I drove it to the gate myself. That's one trailer I don't have to count.
jobs.tts_text: It's gone. 11:59. I drove it to the gate myself. That's one trailer I don't have to count.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: It's at door 3. I put it there. Don't let anybody move it.
jobs.tts_text: It's at door 3. I put it there. Don't let anybody move it.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: The WMS says 12 trailers in the yard. I see 41. The WMS is very optimistic about emptiness.
jobs.tts_text: The WMS says 12 trailers in the yard. I see 41. The WMS is very optimistic about emptiness.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: Trailer 31? The empty, heated one? For the cats?
jobs.tts_text: Trailer 31? The empty, heated one? For the cats?
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: I've been hoping somebody would do something with it.
jobs.tts_text: I've been hoping somebody would do something with it.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact. already backing up.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: I'd love to. Just as soon as you find my clicker.
jobs.tts_text: I'd love to. Just as soon as you find my clicker.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: A lot. (He clicks.) More now.
jobs.tts_text: A lot. More now.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: If you can count them, tell me the number. Nobody's been able to.
jobs.tts_text: If you can count them, tell me the number. Nobody's been able to.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: 143. 147. Wait. 152. I was counting the same orange one.
jobs.tts_text: 143. 147. Wait. 152. I was counting the same orange one.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: Not yet. The WMS has that trailer on a compliance hold. If I pull it into door 3, the whole building will yell at me. Soon.
jobs.tts_text: Not yet. The WMS has that trailer on a compliance hold. If I pull it into door 3, the whole building will yell at me. Soon.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: The WMS has T-9022 on a hold. If I bring it in without an override, the dock kiosk will lock the door on me. Someone needs to clear it. Maybe someone who's not technically here.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: I can't see door 3 from the cab. I need a spotter at the dock, someone who knows when it's clear. Torvald is big enough to see over things.
jobs.tts_text: I can't see door 3 from the cab. I need a spotter at the dock, someone who knows when it's clear. Torvald is big enough to see over things.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: Be at the outbound dock. I need to see you. I need the light green. Get there and radio again.
jobs.tts_text: Be at the outbound dock. I need to see you. I need the light green. Get there and radio again.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: I'd love to talk, but I'm off count without my clicker. It's... somewhere lost.
jobs.tts_text: I'd love to talk, but I'm off count without my clicker. It's... somewhere lost.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.

jobs.text: T-9022 is rolling. I can see the dock. I can't see the light. Torvald?
jobs.tts_text: T-9022 is rolling. I can see the dock. I can't see the light. Torvald?

jobs.speaker: RUFUS
jobs.text: Again.
jobs.tts_text: Again.
jobs.direction: Yard driver; distracted but capable, conversational, matter-of-fact.
